_meta.title: FoodMart grocery demo catalog (Aptech-4 Phase 4)
notes: Persisted catalog source of truth is backend db/demo/foodmart-catalog.json (make seed-demo / up-all).
This file is a frontend mirror for tooling and optional API import dry-run — do not treat as DB seed.
Demo prices only — not market prices.
No brand, rating, stock quantity, or imageUrl — unsupported by product schema.
Images resolved client-side via foodmart-image-map.json by SKU.
